name: Nightly 1.0.0.PRw — 20261018
body:
Automated nightly build of `develop` (20261018).

macOS build is ad-hoc signed (not notarized): after downloading,
run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/icestudio.app`.

### Changes since v1.0.0.PRw-20260630

- fix(boards): Cmod A7-35T info.json is valid JSON again (the nightly build failed in json-minify), menu.json names its folder with the right case, interface FTDI and group XILINX (24ff21e6)
- fix(serial-term): the manifest declares launchAtStartup and gui.type window, as the data check requires (same plugin class as before) (06701753)
- chore(node): .nvmrc names Node 23.3.0, the version the workflows use, for the data check action, the hooks and CONTRIBUTING.md (d2b17493)
- chore(checks): the data check runs in every build workflow and in grunt dist, the hooks find node and msgfmt from a graphical client, CONTRIBUTING.md (248bce86)
- chore(checks): the data files are checked before commit, before push and in CI (55fbb820)
- boards: add Arty S7-25 (Digilent, xc7s25csga324-1) (3f6cfc49)
- Add AppStream metainfo (5800cc64)
- Update menu.json to include Cmod A7-35T (508fc58e)
- Create pinout.json (4ad1967f)
- Create rules.json (41771ec7)
- Create info.json (a9e31db7)
- Update Soan-Papdi board apio ID (34028b96)
- Hardware verified on physical VSDSquadron FM board (9128ad41)
- Add VSDSquadron-FM board files (info, pinout, rules, pcf) (c83cebba)
- Add 'VSDSquadron-FM' to menu.json (c57342e1)
- fix(compiler): stamp 'Top entity' only on main and place dependency banners before their modules (0e6141c3)
- feat(compiler): deterministic wire order and driver-derived wire names (fa12afa6)
- fix(compiler): unify dependency module naming and clean the vinit range (e71814dc)
- feat(compiler): positional names for unlabeled I/O and per-instance custom names (c1774130)
- feat(compiler): human-readable port names in dependency modules (76034479)
- fix(graph): cascade error markers through the module hierarchy with a persistent trail (e2a7d31f)
- feat(compiler): human-readable top port and instance names in generated Verilog (935a76ef)
- revert(upload): drop the Windows 8.3 short-path hack for the bitstream (9f1b564d)
- feat(apioShell): open 'apio graph' in an Icestudio window with pan/zoom and download (9aac92f9)
- fix(boards): build the bitstream before a custom upload command (a4a730dd)
- fix(upload): use an absolute, space-safe bitstream path in custom apio raw commands (e311f368)
- feat(preferences): allow combinational loops and free-form Verilator flags (51f89fee)
- fix(verify): don't corrupt the root design when verifying inside a submodule (b522afb6)
- fix(project-info): write the icon SVG through the writable and bound the preview (ff634b4c)
- feat(preferences): per-project tool settings merged with globals, plus yosys/nextpnr build options (fe36fea5)
- fix(verify): waive MODMISSING for the ECP5 TRELLIS_IO I/O primitive (6d23d75f)
- fix(menu): make Save As inside a submodule export just that module (00337d37)
- fix(boards): use a build-dir-relative bitstream path for openFPGALoader uploads (bf1cc606)
- fix(design): compare canonical sub-design forms when navigating out of a module (1498c344)
- fix(boards): pass --file-type bin to openFPGALoader on ECP5 dongle uploads (d48efdb5)
- style(outputConsole): add braces to single-line ifs to pass jshint (8a39eabb)
- User resizable output console window (8a22b05d)
- User resizable output console window (05d20632)
- User resizable output console window (fd6e2024)
- feat(menu): open examples via volatile temp copies and keep the recent list live (6798ea41)
- feat(examples): open read-only examples from an OS temp copy without asking (867f2e36)
- feat(boards): user boards folder scanned in every board list (a78ba959)
- fix(graph): commit the add batch on block drop to mark the project changed (f0a57c5e)
- revert(graph): drop the batch:stop added after addCell in addDraggableCell (3d2db760)
- fix(graph): mark project changed when adding a module block (c93c40db)
-  fix(design): don't dirty the project when navigating in/out of a module (d4284333)
-  .ihub-card--check is absolute-positioned for the card grid; reused in the   (non-positioned) .ihub-detail--title it escaped to .ihub-wrapper and rendered   over the search box. Scope a detail-only rule making it inline (position:static)   so it sits right after the collection name. (e1fe6b24)
- docs(readme): unify build badges into a single nightly badge (5df30a47)
- fix(boards): correct Soan-Papdi pin label I09 -> IO9 (d76b0c49)
- Latest fixes during editor board tutorial bugs (a8f60205)
- boards(ice40-hx8k-evb): remove hidden duplicate _iCE40HX8K-EVB (9cc5fb31)
- boards(icesugar-pro): map (USB-Blaster) to apio icesugar-pro + upload (3d2d5f8a)
- boards(icesugar-pro): map (FT232H) to apio icesugar-pro + FTDI upload (f26978a2)
- boards(icesugar-pro): map (FT2232H) to apio icesugar-pro + FTDI upload (fe0b7dec)
- boards(sipeed-tang-nano-20k): set apio id sipeed-tang-nano-20k (b6cb01fc)
- boards(sipeed-tang-nano-9k): set apio id sipeed-tang-nano-9k (8d3396f6)
- boards(sipeed-tang-nano-4k): set apio id sipeed-tang-nano-4k (cd4d6c5c)
- boards(sipeed-tang-nano-1k): set apio id sipeed-tang-nano-1k (47b1c0b7)
- boards(sipeed-tang-nano): set apio id sipeed-tang-nano (c48f7c7a)
- boards(colorlight-i5): map (USB-Blaster) to apio colorlight-i5-v7-0 + upload (60325b15)
- boards(colorlight-i5): map (FT232H) to apio colorlight-i5-v7-0 + FTDI upload (f6883402)
- boards(colorlight-i5): map (FT2232H) to apio colorlight-i5-v7-0 + FTDI upload (6833f565)
- fix(boardEditor): allow parentheses in board id validation (0799eda1)
- fix(tools): correct {BITSTREAM} path and add {APIO_CMD} placeholder (8f788fd0)
- fix(win): apio APIO_HOME env var was quoted into the value (668fbe9e)
- Update github node requirements for workflows and remove  arrobas from changelog to avoid unknown false co authors auto detection. (42ca0ea7)
- Add Icestudio version in the tittle bar (issue #926) (f1250694)
- CI(nightly): drop the pre-release badge on nightly releases (81df4b2d)
-  CI(macOS): fix darwin deps install (grunt-appdmg not found) (6e95e7de)
- Removing old scripts to avoid generation errors. Boards should be only managed by boardEditor plugin. (edf22532)
- boardEditor/board selector: sort board lists alphabetically (fb2e6d25)
- build: generate XDC constraints for Xilinx (xc7 / openXC7) boards (0f2df85a)
- boardEditor: single refresh button, Xilinx (xc7) support, basys3 clock fix (894495bf)
-  boardEditor: single reload/regenerate button + regenerated menu.json (2dccf0b2)
- Add boards as an exception for the disk watchdog to allow working with the board editor during development. (623a57af)
- boardEditor: regenerable menu.json + per-board FPGA family (5d7fdc13)

name: v0.12
body:
No changes from **0.12-rc1**

Find more information in the [Release notes](https://github.com/FPGAwars/icestudio/wiki/Release-history#version-012-stable)

## What's Changed from previous release 0.11

* **Apio**: 0.9.5
* **Oss-cad-suite package**: 0.0.9 (3 Oct. 2023)
* **Node** upgraded ➡️ v21.1.0
* **NWJS** upgraded ➡️ 0.83.0 (**NOTE**: ARM uses NWJS 0.60)
* **Chromium** upgraded ➡️ 120.0.6099.129
* Support for MacOs ARM ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Add support for inout ports ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Fix bug in serial terminal speed presets ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Install libfuse2 in github actions for appimage generation ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Updated appimage generation to meet current appimage standards. Grunt appimage removed ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Default collection: bumped to version 0.4.1 ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Automatic sign dmg osx package in github actions ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* OSX M1/M2 cpu github build ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Add tooltips to Label finder, add more translations  ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy))
* IceCream support start ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Edit text strings, add some translations, fix "Installing" translation ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy))
* Improve Gruntfile notes, cleanup ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy))
* Adjust developer notes and script for translation ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy))
* Text edit the Terminal instructions ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy))
* Clean and update dev steps ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy)) 
* Add target to README for opening page ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy)) 
* Update Czech translation. Thanks to nerakino@email.cz
* Spanish translation updated ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Add hover text to side menu (plugins) ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy)) 
* Apio stable version changed to 0.9.5  ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Upgrade to Oss-cad-suite 0.0.9  ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Test and fix code blocks with the tri-state feature ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy)) 
* Test and fix hide/show of the tri-state feature ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy)) 
* Organize Preferences menu and add hide/show of the tri-state feature ([@TimRudy](https://github.com/TimRudy)) 
* Update French translations ([@pcotret](https://github.com/pcotret)) 
* Add support for Theta Machines ETH4K ([@will-hut](https://github.com/will-hut))  
* Alchity-cu: Fix wrong pin numbers reported and fixed by @juanmicro
* Add OSX arm 64 native bundle ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Improve OSX DMG generation with codesign capabilities ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Upgrade to nwjs 0.83.0 ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Added native support for OSX arm64 ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Update japanese translation ([@kanade](https://github.com/kanade-k-1228))
* Fix problems with dmg package bundler for osx ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Add "SysClkMhz" as global value ([@jojo535275](https://github.com/jojo535275))
* Support for signed ports ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Improve name port pattern ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Update compiler.js ([@jojo535275](https://github.com/jojo535275))
* Add support for inout ports  ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))

name: v0.10-rc1
body:
## Changes since 0.9.0-1
* Many Bug fixed ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Serial term plugin: ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
  * Local echo activated by default
  * Theme changed to dark 
  * Hex view mode added
* Added support for the iceWerx board ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Apio bumped to version 0.8.1 ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Apio oss-cad-suite package bumped to 0.0.8 ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Plugin panel: it is auto-hiden when not used. It is shown again when the mouse pointer is over it ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* Icestudio windows have now a minimal size of 800x300 (Before they could be resize to almost 0 x 0)
* Basic menu in the top bar (again) ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Code clean up, commented and refactored ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* First stable plugin version ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* New moveable collection panel ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* New plugins panel ([@cavearr](https://github.com/cavearr))
* **Color names** can now be **translated into any Languages**. Initially they has been translated into Spanish. For now the translated colors are only shown when creating or editing a label, but not in the Label Finder yet ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Bug fixed: Pins assignments are not lost when re-sized ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Toolbox: New Paired Labels menu option: One input label and one output label can be placed at the same time, with the same name ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Japanese translation added (by [@kanade-k-1228](https://github.com/kanade-k-1228))
* Many annoying Graphical Bugs has been fixed: ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
*  NW upgraded: 0.58.0 ➡️ 0.60.0 (2022-01-07)  ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Chromium updated: 95.0.4638.54 ➡️ 97.0.4692.71
* GruntFile refactored, documented and simplified ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Arm Build script removed (included in the Gruntfile) ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))
* Added UPDuino v3.1 support, modified UPDuino v3.0 PCF file to use --warn-no-port instead of -nowarn ([@vr2045](https://github.com/vr2045))
* grunt-contrib-jshint upgraded: 3.0.0 ➡️ 3.1.1 ([@obijuan](https://github.com/Obijuan))

name: v0.9.0-1
body:
Find more information in the [Release notes](https://github.com/FPGAwars/icestudio/wiki/Release-history#version-090-1-stable)

## Changes since 0.9.0

This is a **bug fix Release**. 

This is a Bug fixed release. It fixed a critical bug that avoided to build circuits if icestudio was installed after March the 28th (2022)

```
There are errors in the design...
Error: module 'click'  has no attribute  'get_terminal_size'
```

This bug has been solved in **apio 0.8.0.post1**. Icestudio 0.9.0-1 uses this version by default

Thanks to all the people involve in the testing cycle 😀️

  * Improve dom searching with cache in render system
  * Improve block placement performance

## Changelog
